**Finding: T4C — Compliant (preferred position).**

- **Customer convenience right:** § 9.4 permits termination of the Agreement or any Order Form "without cause," with the notice period set at thirty days by § 29.4 — matching our preferred 30-day right.
- **No penalty / refund:** § 9.4 limits our exposure to accrued Fees and requires Vendor to refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period; § 10.2 repeats the refund of prepaid recurring Fees. No early-termination fee exists anywhere.
- **No Vendor convenience right:** Vendor's termination rights are confined to material breach (§ 9.1), insolvency (§ 9.2) and the infringing-item remedy (§ 20.5, which also bars terminating unaffected Services); § 24.4 blocks termination on our change of control. Nothing lets Vendor exit the three-year term (§ 8.1) for convenience.
- § 7.7's liquidated damages are triggered by late invoice payment, not termination, so they are not an early-termination fee under this rule and are not flagged twice here.

No redline proposed.
